intro: Gilthares Firebough is an elven deckhand held captive atop a tower inside Northwatch Hold. Formerly employed by the Thalo'dan Privateers aboard a moonshine transport between Ratchet and Booty Bay, he seeks any opportunity to escape his Theramore captors.

p: While hauling illicit cargo between Ratchet and Booty Bay, Gilthares Firebough saw his ship blasted to splinters by naval forces out of Theramore. As the sole survivor of the assault, the privateer was dragged ashore in chains and locked away in a tower within Northwatch Hold. Though dressed in vivid red and bearing little affection for the Alliance zealots who slaughtered his crew, Gilthares is not picky about who aids his breakout—so long as they can fight their way down from the ramparts.
